metas.name: Succession
metas.description: Matches the high-stress, fast-paced dialogue and dark, complex character dynamics found in The Bear and BEEF.

metas.name: Severance
metas.description: An intense, mind-bending mystery that echoes the surreal corporate paranoia and psychological suspense of The Twilight Zone and Mindhunter.

metas.name: True Detective
metas.description: Perfect for fans of Mare of Easttown and Sharp Objects; a gritty, atmospheric crime anthology with deep psychological undertones.

metas.name: The Leftovers
metas.description: An emotionally complex, high-stakes mystery drama that explores grief and supernatural uncertainty, appealing to fans of Mare of Easttown and The Twilight Zone.

metas.name: Breaking Bad
metas.description: A masterclass in prestige television and high-stakes criminal evolution, directly aligning with Snowfall and Boardwalk Empire.

metas.name: Better Call Saul
metas.description: Offers the same meticulously crafted tension and brilliant character studies found in Snowfall, Boardwalk Empire, and BEEF.

metas.name: Fargo
metas.description: Balances brutal violence, quirky dark humor, and unpredictable crime plots in a way that matches Inside No. 9 and BEEF.

metas.name: Chernobyl
metas.description: An incredibly tense, high-stakes historical drama that captures the grim realism and dread seen in your documentary and prestige drama preferences.

metas.name: The Americans
metas.description: A highly intense espionage thriller with deep emotional stakes and moral ambiguity, matching the tone of The Night Manager and Mindhunter.

metas.name: Mr. Robot
metas.description: A dark, psychological thriller with a complex anti-hero that matches the cat-and-mouse intellectual chess game of Death Note.

metas.name: Barry
metas.description: A perfect blend of dark comedy, intense violence, and psychological dread that fits right alongside BEEF and Atlanta.

metas.name: Dark
metas.description: A complex, puzzle-box sci-fi mystery that demands your full attention, building heavily on themes seen in Stranger Things and The X-Files.

metas.name: Monster
metas.description: This highly-rated anime is a gritty, realistic psychological thriller that perfectly complements Death Note and Mindhunter.

metas.name: Yellowjackets
metas.description: Combines psychological survival horror, mystery, and deep trauma, matching the intense, dark vibes of Sharp Objects and Them.

metas.name: The Haunting of Hill House
metas.description: An emotionally devastating, prestige horror drama with incredible cinematography and complex themes, matching Them and Sharp Objects.

metas.name: Black Mirror
metas.description: An anthology series exploring the dark side of technology, mirroring the sci-fi paranoia and episodic nature of Love, Death & Robots and The Twilight Zone.

metas.name: Preacher
metas.description: Adapting another comic by Garth Ennis, this offers the same violent, irreverent, and chaotic energy as The Boys.

metas.name: Peaky Blinders
metas.description: A stylish, ruthless crime drama filled with intense power struggles, matching Boardwalk Empire and Snowfall.

metas.name: The Last of Us
metas.description: A prestigious, high-stakes post-apocalyptic drama that captures the survival tension and emotional depth seen in Fallout.

metas.name: Attack on Titan
metas.description: An intense, high-stakes anime with massive scale, dark themes, and relentless action that fits fans of Invincible and Jujutsu Kaisen.

metas.name: Vinland Saga
metas.description: An exceptionally animated, emotionally complex, and violent historical epic that appeals to fans of Invincible and Jujutsu Kaisen.

metas.name: Cyberpunk: Edgerunners
metas.description: A visually spectacular, hyper-violent sci-fi anime that aligns perfectly with the tone of Love, Death & Robots and Invincible.

metas.name: Devs
metas.description: A slow-burn, philosophically challenging sci-fi thriller from Alex Garland that matches the intellectual weight of Foundation.

metas.name: Westworld
metas.description: An ambitious, mind-bending sci-fi series dealing with artificial intelligence, mystery, and high-stakes action, akin to Fallout and Foundation.

metas.name: Ozark
metas.description: A tense crime thriller about money laundering and survival, reflecting the grittiness and danger of Snowfall and Boardwalk Empire.

metas.name: Narcos
metas.description: A realistic, brutal look at the rise of the drug trade that heavily aligns with the historical crime themes of Snowfall and Boardwalk Empire.

metas.name: The Wire
metas.description: Widely regarded as one of the greatest crime dramas ever, it offers unparalleled realism and institutional critique, matching Snowfall.

metas.name: Silo
metas.description: A tense, post-apocalyptic underground mystery that captures the claustrophobia and world-building of Fallout and The Expanse.

metas.name: Slow Horses
metas.description: A gritty, critically acclaimed espionage thriller with sharp writing and cynical humor, perfect for fans of The Night Manager.

metas.name: Scavengers Reign
metas.description: An incredibly imaginative, beautiful, and sometimes terrifying sci-fi animation that fans of Love, Death & Robots will love.

metas.name: Andor
metas.description: A mature, high-stakes political thriller set in space, carrying the complex narrative tone of Foundation and The Expanse.

metas.name: The Terror
metas.description: An intense, atmospheric horror series that blends historical realism with supernatural dread, matching Them and Sharp Objects.

metas.name: ZeroZeroZero
metas.description: An incredibly realistic, globetrotting crime thriller tracking a single shipment of cocaine, appealing directly to fans of Snowfall.

metas.name: Mr. Inbetween
metas.description: A hidden gem dark comedy-drama about a hitman balancing family life and extreme violence, perfect for fans of Barry and BEEF.

metas.name: Giri/Haji
metas.description: A stylish, emotionally complex cross-cultural crime drama that moves between London and Tokyo, offering a great balance of action and depth.

metas.name: The Knick
metas.description: An incredibly intense, gritty medical drama directed by Steven Soderbergh, offering a high-stress environment that matches the tension of The Bear.

metas.name: Penny Dreadful
metas.description: An atmospheric, gothic horror series with exceptional performances, offering a similar artistic dread to Hannibal and Them.

metas.name: Big Little Lies
metas.description: A highly-acclaimed mystery drama exploring dark secrets, trauma, and domestic tension, directly matching Sharp Objects and Mare of Easttown.

metas.name: Station Eleven
metas.description: An incredibly poetic, prestige sci-fi drama about rebuilding society after a pandemic, matching the thematic depth of The Leftovers.

metas.name: Banshee
metas.description: A hyper-violent, pulpy, and highly engaging action-crime series that matches the adrenaline and sheer entertainment value of The Boys.
